top_categories.workout_context: Race-pace efforts that mimic Gran Fondo Başkent's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before August.
Gran Fondo Başkent's mixed terrain forces constant power changes. Accelerate over rises and out of corners, settle on the open road, and repeat for 56 miles.
When someone attacks on mixed terrain, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
56 miles on mixed terrain burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
72ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
At Gran Fondo Başkent, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Gran Fondo Başkent, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Gran Fondo Başkent. Train it until it feels boring.
Short, max efforts are unavoidable. Punchy climbs, gap closures, attacks on mixed terrain. If you haven't trained them, you'll crack.
Base fitness for Gran Fondo Başkent. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 4,058ft of climbing on mixed terrain does to your power file on race day.
Varied gradients on mixed terrain demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for Gran Fondo Başkent’s 56 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum, more in heat.
race_overlay.altitude: Moderate altitude at Gran Fondo Başkent. Arrive 2–3 days early. Reduce intensity expectations by 5–10%. Hydrate aggressively.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Gran Fondo Başkent requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on mixed terrain to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Race Simulation, Road Specific, and VO2max to prepare you for 56 miles of mixed terrain in Ankara, Turkey.
